Q2.descr: Generic SOT-323/SC-70 3-lead MOSFET. Land + courtyard reused verbatim from SOT-323_BAT54SW (same JEDEC package, easyeda2kicad vendor land for C78606) so the placement scans that proved SC-70 fits this board still apply. Pin 1 = gate, 2 = source, 3 = drain — the universal 3-lead SOT-23/SOT-323 MOSFET convention, confirmed for CJ2101 (P-ch) and BSS138W (N-ch).
